audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Gangplank level 1 and level 6 and give Darius the 2-item row — the exact inverse of the lane. The already-published Darius page sets the chart to Darius through first item with Gangplank owning 2+ items.
audit.why: whys[0] itself says Darius walks you down at level 1, and the early section says levels 1-3 are his 'full stop'. The late section says by two items your keg chain zones him off the wave and he cannot touch you — that is your row, not his. The mirror already carries Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Gangplank, so leaving this would put the two pages in direct contradiction and mirror-fix would overwrite it anyway.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 to Darius, row 6 to Gangplank, matching the mirror, with ratings inverted and whys[2]-[4] rewritten so the reasons agree with the sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes says 'Darius: Apprehend online, level 6, first item' with no numbers, and phases[4].why treats level 6 as a generic reassessment.
audit.why: His spikes are level 1-2 (Apprehend into the outer blade of Decimate, which heals him off you), and level 6 Noxian Guillotine (120s at rank 1, true damage scaled on Hemorrhage stacks, cooldown refreshed on a kill). Yours is the Sheen window and then two items, where chained detonations out-range his entire kit — his only reach is a 535-range pull on 26s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Real numbers in breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t; whys[4] now states that Cannon Barrage denies the Guillotine reset without winning the duel.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names only Apprehend and describes it as 'his all-in start. Cleanse the slow.' Hemorrhage, Decimate, Crippling Strike and Noxian Guillotine never appear.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 and 535 range — by far the longest cooldown in his kit and his only way to reach you, which makes it the window the whole lane is played around. Decimate (9s) heals him only off the outer blade. Crippling Strike (5s) is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the step-back tell. Hemorrhage stacks five times and enrages him at max. Noxian Guillotine is true damage scaled by those stacks and refreshes on a kill, so armour is not the answer.
audit.corrected: Named all four with their cooldowns across tldr, dosFull, dontsFull, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' and breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers.
audit.why: Apprehend 26s, Decimate 9s, Crippling Strike 5s, Noxian Guillotine 120s, Remove Scurvy 22s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d now give the bait-the-pull-then-step-up sequence against the 26s window.
